concept.observed: A reel framed as an animator's notebook: a bouncing ball with handwritten notes, one-word verb cards that perform themselves, an easing curve with handles, and a dot on an arc with ghost copies.
concept.interpreted: Teaches the principles while demonstrating them.

communication_style.observed: Handwritten annotations (squash, slow in/slow out, stagger), timeline ruler at the bottom, no narration.

palette.observed: Light grey paper and near-black cards; blue ball; red accents for annotations and SNAP.

typography.observed: Condensed heavy caps for verbs; handwritten-style notes; mono timecodes.

motion.observed: Ball bounce with squash and ghost trail; STRETCH widens, SPIN rotates, SNAP lands on guide lines, a heavy word drops with blur.

easing.observed: An S-shaped curve with bezier handles is drawn and annotated.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Measured median shot 1.83 s; cuts at 3.77, 5.17, 5.57, 8.47 and 13.17 s.

transitions.observed: Re-read 2026-11-27: 5 boundaries (2 cut, 1 grow, 1 cover, 1 continuous). Corrected the same night from a 30 fps strip (13.08-13.30 s): 13.17 s is a bloom from the ball, not a disc sweeping in from the left. 2.10 s continuous: the sketched notes fade on the same light page and the headline word rises letter by letter in place; the bouncing ball lands as its full stop (1.98-2.45 s). 3.77 s cut: light to dark; the next word's letters drop in with a vertical smear (3.78-4.05 s). 5.57 s cut: dark word card to a light graph page through one frame of horizontal streaks (5.58 s). 8.47 s cover: a dark panel pushes in from the right with a blurred leading edge and takes the frame in about 0.13 s (8.42-8.55 s). 13.17 s grow: the ball shrinks to a sliver (13.05-13.12 s), then a white disc with echo rings blooms from the ball (13.15 s), passes the frame edge by about 13.21 s and becomes the white page; the ball stays as the full stop while the closing name builds letter by letter. Earlier reading (2026-10-30): Mostly hard cuts between light and dark cards.
transitions.interpreted: Cuts flip between light and dark cards; the page push and the ball's ring bloom are the two section turns.

audio_and_sync.observed: 2.8 onsets/s; 80% of boundaries within 50 ms of an onset (chance 31%).

motifs.observed: Annotation layer and onion skins: the process made visible.

sound_design.observed: Integrated -11.7 LUFS (the loudest of the 14), LRA 4.6 LU, true peak -0.1 dBTP. 9 accents (36 a minute). Accents on cuts 0.00 against chance 0.11 (5 boundaries), while weaker onsets sit near boundaries 0.80 against 0.31. Silence 0.05-0.44 s at the head; head -13.0 dB, tail -4.8 dB. Listen sheet: accents on the ball's floor contacts where it squashes (0.51, 0.98 s), the word MOVE landing (2.39 s), the verb cards STRETCH and SNAP (4.27, 5.20 s) and the arc of the follow-through study (8.96, 9.89 s).
sound_design.interpreted: Sound on the contact, the animation-principles way: the bounce sounds where it squashes; strong accents avoid the cuts.

narration.observed: Sparse by the numbers (5 words in 3 phrases, 40% coverage, 0.84 words/s) but the phrase frames (4.12-5.96, 8.83-10.42, 11.80-14.34 s) show verb cards, a dot-trail study and the end card; no speaker on any phrase frame; 1-2 word 'phrases' are dictation noise over the music. Verdict: none.
